commit.message:
feat(infrastructure): Complete Task P - Infrastructure & DevOps

🏗️ Production-Ready Infrastructure:
- Kong API Gateway with rate limiting, CORS, JWT auth, and service routing
- Kubernetes manifests with auto-scaling, health checks, and resource management
- GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline with multi-language support and security scanning
- Prometheus/Grafana monitoring stack with comprehensive metrics and alerting
- Complete alerting system for business, performance, and infrastructure monitoring

🚪 Kong API Gateway:
- Declarative configuration for all EcoMarket microservices
- Rate limiting per service with appropriate thresholds
- CORS configuration for web applications
- JWT authentication and consumer management
- Prometheus metrics integration for observability

☸️ Kubernetes Orchestration:
- Production namespace with secrets and config management
- Service deployments with HPA for automatic scaling
- Health checks and resource limits for all services
- RBAC and service account configuration
- Multi-service deployment strategy

🔄 CI/CD Pipeline:
- Matrix builds supporting Node.js, Python, and Go services
- Security vulnerability scanning with Trivy
- Multi-stage deployment (staging → production)
- Frontend deployment automation to CDN
- Smoke tests and health verification

📊 Monitoring & Alerting:
- Prometheus configuration with service discovery
- Grafana dashboards and data source provisioning
- Node Exporter for system metrics collection
- Comprehensive alert rules for all scenarios
- Business logic alerts for EcoMarket-specific metrics

🔧 Infrastructure Components:
- Complete namespace and resource management
- Secret and configuration management
- Service mesh preparation with security policies
- Production-grade scaling and reliability
- Documentation and operational runbooks

Task P Status: ✅ COMPLETED
